'''ICC-5537''' was the designation of a [[20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport]] [[train]] stationed on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TOG" /> In the year [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date ref">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Vandor]] and in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Vandor and in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> it [[transport]]ed 400 [[kilogram]]s of the [[Fuel|hyperfuel]] [[coaxium]] across the [[Iridium Mountains|Iridium]] [[Mountain]]s to the [[Crispin Imperial Depository]], guarded by [[range trooper]]s led by [[Captain]] [[Denwade Banevans]].<ref name="TOG" /> [[Han Solo]] and a [[Beckett's gang|group]] of thieves led by [[Tobias Beckett]] attempted to steal the valuable cargo on behalf of the [[Five Crime Syndicates|criminal syndicate]] [[Crimson Dawn]]. The rangetroopers stationed to defend the train attacked them and shortly thereafter, [[Enfys Nest]]'s [[Cloud-Riders]] also arrived on scene, planning to take the coaxium for themselves. In the course of the [[Heist on Vandor|heist]], [[Val]] detonated a [[bomb]], destroying a [[bridge]] section of the conveyex track and sending ICC-5537 into the gorge below. Caught between the two opposing groups of thieves, the train's cargo was also destroyed.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The 20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport designated as ICC-5537, simply referred to as "Imperial train" in the film's script, was designed by the [[Lucasfilm]] design supervisor [[James Clyne]].<ref name="Who Designed This">{{SW|url=news/designing-solo-a-star-wars-story-part-3-conveyex-train-heist|text=Designing ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'', Part 3: Pulling Off the Train Heist}}</ref>
